review.verdict: Correct, kind casting (robot-for-AI, human-for-worker) and a clean left-side gag, but the right vignette's surveillance beat is muted without a gaze cue, the planned vertical divider is missing, and the robot breaches the safe area — a passing but shaky piece that needs a composition tighten-up.
revisionNotes: Give human1 a clear upward gaze (tilt head, eyes up) or add a thin dotted sightline from sensor1's eye to the worker so the 'being watched' beat reads instantly instead of requiring the caption.
robot1 breaches the safe area per lint (x 22…324) — nudge it to x≈0.20 or drop scale to 0.8 so its raised arm clears the margin.

Brief called for a thin vertical divider between the two vignettes; none is rendered, so the piece reads as one busy scene rather than an intentional two-panel contrast — add the divider or otherwise visually separate left/right.
sign1 renders as a tall blank picket sign on a stick rather than a small flyer; scale it down (~0.6) and hold it at chest height to match 'flyer' and reduce clutter on the right third.
Door-and-split-palette motifs (OPEN door, RISK/AI doors) recur in recent sloppers — vary the ground/prop silhouette next time for freshness.
